scope: explicit bounded pack JSON diagnostics, attached-schema coverage, exact source handoff and portable metadata report
checks: three tiny sources run through the actual worker module: root/syntax/duplicate and exact schema locations, unknown large-number tokens untouched, attached-schema coverage separate from no-schema sources
portable metadata report excludes full source/schema text and symbols; file/finding admission, failed reads and cancelled capture are explicit instead of reporting a clear pack
controlled timeout terminates synchronous work, next check starts a fresh worker, late results cannot settle it, simultaneous requests refuse and close rejects pending work
controlled problems dialog runs only on explicit request, filters captured schema findings, exports a report, navigates a selected issue and suppresses cancelled/stale-schema publication
actual app reader uses captured open text/schema without a disk read, caches saved category schema once, and issue handoff accepts owned source but refuses a changed saved ETag
limits: Three tiny sources and one authored attached schema, actual Node worker module and controlled DOM/editor/timeout hosts only. JSON checks use bounded parsing and the existing partial local schema validator, not native engine/reference validation. Missing/failed schema coverage and all capture omissions remain explicit. Per-source worker response timeout is an interruption policy, not a performance result. Actual browser worker startup/termination/layout/focus/network/IndexedDB/multi-tab and full native/client/release verification remain pending. No native build/generation, registry/state sweep, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow.
